status: Fixed and verified in 2026-09-02 cleanup lane
finding: Protected override audit files can be selected into a governed commit bundle as task-owned artifacts, but the active task direction lock may not automatically include them.
expectedBehavior: Any generated task-owned protected override audit included by the commit bundle should either be automatically allowed by the direction-lock gate or trigger a precise scope-amendment flow before staging.
evidenceOrRepro: FABLE-005 commit initially failed on `.atm/history/protected-override-audit/2026-07-12T15-59-52-259Z-POA-0e9840962464.json`; 0188 failed on two protected override audit files. Both were current-task artifacts but outside `taskDirectionLock.allowedFiles`; `tasks scope add` was required before commit. Current source resolves only concrete audit receipts whose JSON payload names the current task in both commit admission and staging scope. Verified 2026-09-02: `commit-authority-scopes.test.ts` admits own.json and rejects foreign.json; `sealed-commit-attribution.test.ts` retains fail-closed committed-tree attribution.
followUp: Resolved: task-owned protected-override audit receipts are included by the direction-lock allowed-file model, while foreign audit receipts remain excluded.
